name: Atomstack A20 Pro
tagline: Mid-tier Atomstack with compressed beam : sweet spot between A5 and A40
tldr: The A20 Pro sits in Atomstack's lineup between budget A5 and flagship A40. Strong engraving detail with a more rigid frame than entry models. A sensible upgrade path if A5 feels slow but A40 is over budget.
mainObjective: Mid-range Atomstack for detailed engraving & reliable thin-wood cutting

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cons: A40 only modestly more for power users
beginnerNotes: Compare A20 Pro vs Sculpfun S30 Ultra at similar price : S30 often wins on cutting community tips; A20 wins on engraving detail for some users.
proTips: Atomstack's F60 air assist kit is worth adding before pushing cut depth : charring drops significantly on 5–6 mm basswood.
primaryUse: Mid-tier open-frame Atomstack for detailed engraving and moderate thin-wood cutting.
